channel.title: AI - Ars Technica
channel.description: Serving the Technologist since 1998. News, reviews, and analysis.

item.title: Google will invest as much as $40 billion in Anthropic
item.description: This follows a similar, but smaller, investment by Amazon just days ago.

item.title: Report: Samsung execs worried company could lose money on smartphones for the first time
item.description: The AI-driven memory shortage is hitting Samsung's bottom line.

item.title: Man faces 5 years in prison for using AI to fake sighting of runaway wolf
item.description: Beloved wolf gripped the nation after burrowing out of the zoo.

item.title: US accuses China of “industrial-scale” AI theft. China says it’s “slander.”
item.description: Trump-Xi summit may be rocked by US mulling huge sanctions.

item.title: Greenhouse gases from data center boom could outpace entire nations
item.description: Plants from OpenAI, Meta, xAI, and Microsoft could emit more than 129M tons annually.

item.title: Anthropic tested removing Claude Code from the Pro plan
item.description: Untenable demand has Anthropic exploring new approaches to rationing its service.

item.title: Google unveils two new TPUs designed for the "agentic era"
item.description: Google's new generation of Tensor AI chips is actually two chips, one for inference and one for training.

item.title: Indian med student rakes in thousands with AI-generated MAGA hottie
item.description: "Emily Hart" is a young, AI-created conservative woman who likes to take off her clothes.

item.title: Pentagon wants $54B for drones, more than most nations’ military budgets
item.description: The proposed Pentagon drone investment rivals Ukraine’s entire military budget.

item.title: Mozilla: Anthropic's Mythos found 271 security vulnerabilities in Firefox 150
item.description: CTO says new AI model is "every bit as capable" as world's best security researchers.

item.title: Florida probes ChatGPT role in mass shooting. OpenAI says bot "not responsible."
item.description: Can ChatGPT be blamed for a mass shooting? Florida is investigating.

item.title: Report: Meta will train AI agents by tracking employees' mouse, keyboard use
item.description: Move highlights the difficulty of finding high-quality interactive training data.

item.title: Anthropic gets $5B investment from Amazon, will use it to buy Amazon chips
item.description: Anthropic secures 5 gigawatts of Amazon’s custom silicon as Claude demand soars.

item.title: Robot runner handily beats humans in half-marathon, setting new record
item.description: A humanoid robot's record half-marathon run shows China's speed in robotics.

item.title: Deezer says 44% of new music uploads are AI-generated, most streams are fraudulent
item.description: AI tracks account for a small fraction of Deezer streams, and most are demonetized for fraud.

item.title: Anthropic's Mythos AI model sparks fears of turbocharged hacking
item.description: Cyberdefenses could be exposed faster than fixes could be deployed.

item.title: Satellite and drone images reveal big delays in US data center construction
item.description: Data centers face construction delays and energy bottleneck as resistance grows.

item.title: Meta's AI spending spree is helping make its Quest headsets more expensive
item.description: Prices for "critical components" are surging because of massive data center investments.

item.title: OpenAI starts offering a biology-tuned LLM
item.description: GPT-Rosalind is an LLM trained on biology workflows, available in closed access.

item.title: Mozilla launches Thunderbolt AI client with focus on self-hosted infrastructure
item.description: New tool builds on deepset’s Haystack toward a “decentralized open source AI ecosystem.”
